payload.feature:
Decision 0041 (docs/decisions/0041-one-office-per-seat.md) is accepted; rulings 1 to 5 have landed, and the roster slice already added agents/triage.json with its charter. This slice enacts ruling 6 exactly as written — triage is a phase, a gate, and a chief's office — with its enforcement binding, and nothing of rulings 7 and 8. Read the decision first; it is the commission.

What ruling 6 rules, restated for the enactment. The seat is `triage`, class gate, hired from the library agent the roster slice added (fable xhigh, then opus max), one attempt, 1,800 seconds. It reads the commission, the realm's house rules where a realm names them, and the tree the commission names; it reads no journal, no fleet and no history — fresh and blind, decision 0020's temperament — and its charter says so; what Muninn knows reaches it only as text inside the commission. It writes the framing intake writes today (`.forge/tasks/<slug>.md`: goal, expected files, tests, non-goals, constitutional constraints) and rules one class from a closed vocabulary, `chore`, `feature`, `design`, `engine`, `escalate`, as its typed result; `notes` carries the reasoning and, for `escalate`, the questions or the refusal. The table routes on the result: `chore` and `feature` enter implement; `design` and `engine` enter design; `escalate` parks with the reasoning as the park reason (a rule with `park: true`), so a refusal is a journal fact and never a sentence in a framing. Triage subsumes intake in any recipe that seats both: a table with a triage phase has no intake phase.

The class is a journal fact the fold exposes. `strategy` joins the evaluation inputs as an engine-owned input of enumerated kind — the last successful triage result of the run, one of the five classes — that a rule may test with a new condition key `strategy_in: [...]` in crates/brokkr-core/src/policy.rs (closed vocabulary, validated at load like every other key); a seat that claims `strategy` has the claim dropped, and a bundle that declares it fails compilation (decision 0007), pinned in ENGINE_OWNED_INPUTS in brokkr-runtime. The graph and the TUI show the class beside the triage phase the way they show a ruling.

The return edge ruling 5(d) prepared: the implementer's `oversized` result — the work exceeds the class triage ruled — returns to `triage` while `visits_triage` is below 2 and parks at exhaustion; the rule exists only in tables with a triage phase, and the roster test's pin that such a table must carry it now has a table to check.

The recipe. `recipes/triage`, the routing form: phases triage, design, implement, verify, review, ship, done, stop; `fast`'s constitution below triage including ruling 5's edges; the design phase seats what `recipes/sdd`'s design seat seats today (the council sequence, until decision 0042's slices reshape it); the implement, verify, review and ship seats hire as `fast` does today (verify and ship as boxed exec if that slice has landed, otherwise as the library seats them). Its README states the routing table, the class vocabulary, and that it is the routing form of ruling 6 — ruling 7's select seats come later and are named as the reason a `chore` here still runs `fast`'s crew. `recipes/ember` and `recipes/sdd` keep their intake seats until ruling 7 folds them into cases; do not touch them here.

Tests. crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/triage_shape.rs (new): triage precedes every path from `initial`; each of the five classes has exactly one rule; `escalate` parks; `strategy` is engine-owned (a seat claim dropped, a declaration refused at compile); the `oversized` edge lands on triage and is bounded; the protected review gate is unchanged and the constitutional lint passes. A table test per arm in brokkr-core for `strategy_in`. A machine-proof scenario runs the recipe through a fake driver that rules `chore`, then one that rules `escalate` and parks. The witness pin for the new recipe and the moved compose pins, re-pinned with the reason.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh, run with stdin closed: </dev/null) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; cargo test --workspace green; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only — `strategy_in` is a vocabulary word of the v2 table the way `visits_<phase>_gte` was, not a schema change; if you believe a contract change is needed, report blocked and say why; the decision index docs/decisions/README.md must keep every row main carries in number order; do not name the private neighbours in prose; keep the CLI list "claude, codex or dsh" whenever a list of harnesses appears; commit in the repository's style and never push.

Two rules learned on the previous fire, stated up front: every test that compares a path the product reports or prints against a path the test built compares them as `Path`s or after canonicalizing both sides — never as strings with a separator inside a component — because macOS's temp directory is a symlink and Windows paths carry a verbatim prefix and backslashes; and paths inside a hands box are POSIX strings joined with `/` whatever the host. The CI test job now runs with `--no-fail-fast`, so a platform reports every failing binary at once.

result.notes: Enacted decision 0041 ruling 6: added the triage routing recipe and blind chief gate, journal-owned strategy with strategy_in policy routing, bounded oversized return, UI class display, machine proofs, and witness pins. cargo test --workspace, clippy -D warnings, fmt, and literal 100% exact coverage all pass; committed as 404b803.

cargo test --workspace: 58 successful test-suite summaries, 0 failed; cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self: 1 bundle compiled, 0 failed (offline from the bound Cargo registry cache)

Reviewed 404b803 (the run's single commit on top of 3a81c68) against decision 0041 ruling 6 across correctness, simplicity and security. Verified: cargo fmt --check clean; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean (exit 0); verifier reported cargo test --workspace green. NOT verified: scripts/coverage-exact.sh cannot be launched from a seat (sandbox refuses the script); the implementer reports literal 100%, nobody else has run it this fire. Correctness holds: triage is the initial phase and the only door; each class has exactly one arm; escalate parks and the engine substitutes the seat's notes as the park reason (journal fact, Safe-rendered); strategy is fold-derived from transition/decided on triage, listed in ENGINE_OWNED_INPUTS, declaration refused at compile, strategy_in validated at load against the closed STRATEGIES and fail-closed at evaluation (absent -> no match, unknown value -> NoRule problem); oversized returns to triage at visits_triage 1 and parks at 2; fast's review rules are inherited unchanged; ./drivers/speckit_check.sh resolves bundle-relative so the copied driver is correct; witness and compose pins added for cdf869d8. FINDINGS, none above low: (1) low, docs — docs/guides/recipe-authoring.md's condition-vocabulary table (line ~528) still omits strategy_in and the engine-owned-inputs paragraph (line ~213) omits strategy, though both claim to enumerate the closed sets the framing says strategy_in joins. (2) low, correctness/design — crates/brokkr-runtime/src/engine.rs:597-611 withholds last_decision AND returned_from from triage on the oversized return, so the second ruling never sees the implementer's oversized finding; ruling 5 says a finding travels to the seat that owns it, ruling 6 says triage is blind, the implementer chose blind and commented it — the operator should rule which wins, the code is consistent with the framing as written. (3) info, simplicity — crates/brokkr-cli/tests/machine_proof.rs drives a hand-copied TRIAGE_POLICY, not the compiled recipes/triage, matching the file's idiom but the framing said 'runs the recipe'; the shipped design sequence is never executed end to end. (4) info, test strength — the 'claim dropped' assertion in machine_proof passes via the undeclared-claim drop (engine.rs:1598-1599) whether or not strategy is engine-owned; the real fence is the compile refusal plus ENGINE_OWNED_INPUTS membership in triage_shape.rs, which do pin it; the trailing ENGINE_VERSION == CARGO_PKG_VERSION assertion in triage_shape.rs is unrelated noise. (5) info, simplicity — the engine hardcodes the phase name 'triage' and the pair triage/escalate (engine.rs:598, 606, 1747) plus fold.rs:368 and brokkr-view lib.rs:2026; consistent with the decision naming the seat, but no table can opt in or out. (6) info, security observation, no defect — a seat's free-text notes now become the run's park reason on triage/escalate; the journal field is a JSON string and every renderer wraps it in Safe, so no injection path was found; this is simply a new seat-controlled surface to remember. No journal tamper path, no credential touched, no fail-closed behaviour weakened; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json untouched; docs/decisions/README.md untouched; prose lists no harness and names no private neighbour. Read-only: no files changed, no commits.
